original_test_intent: Verify the Type 13 Current Language string index resolves to the approved BIOS language, belongs to the advertised installable-language set under the selected identifier format and remains stable after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 13 records, preserve current-language index and exact value together with flags/count/all installable strings, validate index range, membership and approved default/current policy, then repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves expected current language, identifier normalization and reboot plan. Visual confirmation of BIOS UI language or changing the selection is optional separate work.
required_inputs: Expected current language for the approved BIOS configuration
Expected Type 13 format flag and locale normalization rules
Policy for default versus user-selected current language and whether persistence is required
Validated parser plus approved reboot/OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS collection; do not change BIOS or OS language.
Preserve raw current-language index and exact resolved string; text alone cannot reveal invalid/out-of-range reference handling.
Validate membership against the same record's full installable list and interpret both under its format flag.
Do not claim BIOS UI rendering, input method or OS locale matches this metadata unless separately tested.
Stop on invalid index, unsupported/nonmember language, unexpected drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Resolve the current-language index, validate format/list membership and approved exact/normalized value, and compare before/after reboot.
Do not change language settings, perform UI acceptance or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve current/default language, normalization and persistence expectations.
Approve reboot/recovery, arrange separate UI validation if required and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The field label is correct, but filtered text drops the raw index, format flag and full installable list needed to prove valid membership.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 13 data and report current-language raw index/exact value together with flags and every indexed installable language before applying policy normalization.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Current Language scope, Type 13 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.status: INDEX AND SET-MEMBERSHIP CURRENT LANGUAGE VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Resolve the raw current-language index, range-check it against the Type 13 string set, validate exact/normalized membership using the flag-selected format and compare the configured value across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 13 BIOS Language Information implementations.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS and parser/dmidecode versions plus approved configuration/policy revision.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 13 Current Language index, Flags and installable-language semantics, approved BIOS language policy and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw index integrity, full-set membership and format-aware normalization instead of comparing a rendered string fragment.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; detects invalid indices, nonmember selections and format alias errors without adding UI claims.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved current language, installable set and format/normalization policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS current-language metadata may not prove every interactive BIOS page visibly uses that language.

project_override_considerations: A project may choose a different current/default language, but must keep it within the approved installable set, identify the configuration state and not equate metadata persistence with UI localization quality.
expected_evidence: Approved current/default language, installable set, format and normalization/persistence policy
Complete pre-reboot Type 13 record with raw current index, exact value, flags and indexed full language list
Index-range, set-membership and exact/normalized comparison results
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot comparison
Engineer verdict; optional UI evidence separate

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently targets the Type 13 current-language metadata and reboot persistence.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Index resolution and set membership are safely automatable; missing expected selection is readiness only.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw index, format and full-set membership integrity.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps UI/locale boundaries while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE metadata capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates optional UI observation, project selection and engineer verdict from execution classification.

review_improvement: Prevents a plausible rendered language from passing when its raw index is invalid or its value is absent from the advertised set.
independent_technical_reasoning: Current Language is an indexed Type 13 string; range, membership, normalization and persistence checks are deterministic software operations.
